notes: Started from current GitHub main October 3 approved master, 357 listings. Removed 39 expired occurrences; active multi-day/seasonal events retained.

62 added listings include newly discovered October recurring occurrences and the second Art Trails weekend; not all were newly announced. Recurring additions cover verified October occurrences only, not unsupported longer date ranges.

All 39 entries in the KJZY Community Calendar were compared against the master. Added missing walks, farmers markets, October 4 Jazz in the Plaza, October 7 Big Band Jazz, and the October 31 library Halloween event. Library official time is 3–5:30 PM, correcting AM on KJZY. October 13 The Last Twins remains present.

Art Trails gallery listing split into October 10–11 and 17–18 based on the explicit current KJZY description. Organizer gallery page confirms venue but gives no dated schedule. Downtown Sound updated to include the opening act named by its organizer.
All eight Finley occurrences retained byte-for-byte and current city exceptions checked. Balletto, Battaglini, styles, favicon, search code, Calendar Sources and no Submit Your Event panel preserved.
Actual HTML checked for chronological order, no duplicate rows, 380 listings and ten unique month headings. Summary total matches displayed total.
All 30 listed source URLs attempted. Some sources and paginated calendars could not be completely checked; this is not an exhaustive re-verification of every future event.

Incomplete access: Press Democrat restrictions; Sonoma.com errors; Eventbrite throttling; NorCal Public Media restrictions; Fair, Visit Santa Rosa, Petaluma Voice and Cotati embedded calendars. GoGrape redirects to a transport site. Parks registration pages blocked automated requests. Broad Tourism/Sonoma Valley/Happening calendars were only partially covered.

296 existing event URLs checked: 103 returned HTTP 200; 193 rejected or errored on automated requests. No HTTP 404/410 found. Access failures were not treated as cancellations or grounds for removal. Some new candidate details also failed and those candidates were withheld.
Evvnt independent verification incomplete; no unverified Evvnt candidates imported.
No new confirmed cancellation/postponement removal. Festival Calentano remains excluded with official date TBD.

Unresolved: Murder Mystery at Gables is October 23 on KJZY versus October 24 on Tourism; organizer homepage did not resolve this. Existing October 24 retained. Ross Street October 23 Mariachi/Norbays conflict remains; existing Mariachi retained. Harvest Open House generic link remains.

KJZY recurring ranges beyond specifically verified occurrences were not extrapolated. Big Band Jazz only October 7 independently verified; Jazz in the Plaza only October 4 added. Unsupported Women Veterans 2026 listing remains excluded because linked evidence is from 2025. Windsor Senior Recreation Center is a program/facility directory, not one dated event.
Petaluma Walnut Park organizer page mixes stale November 2024 content with current October programming; additions use October Saturdays corroborated by KJZY, not the stale November text.
